name: Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ 13 TOPS (Hailo-8L), product code SC1785

drawing_files.what: official dimensioned top-view drawing (caption: all measurements approximate, in mm)
official product brief, Oct 2024; page 4 'Physical specification' carries the same drawing as vector

license: n/a (no CAD). Drawing and brief are Raspberry Pi Ltd documentation.

dims_mm.mounting_holes: 4 holes on a 58 x 49 rectangle, centres 3.5 from the left and bottom edges (matches Pi 5 holes); Pi 5 holes are Ø2.7
dims_mm.gpio_header: 2x20 header along the top edge; the drawing dimensions its centre 29 from the left mounting-hole centre. Ships with a 16 mm stacking header
dims_mm.left_edge_notch: notch 5 deep, 18 tall, for the PCIe FFC connector; it starts 17.5 below the top edge and ends 21 above the bottom edge; the FFC connector sits at the notch's inner edge
dims_mm.bottom_right_cutout: 10 wide x 16 tall, starting 47.5 from the left edge; a 7.5-wide strip carrying a mounting hole remains at the right
dims_mm.npu: Hailo NPU metal-lid package about 17 x 17, placed left of centre (drawing)
dims_mm.other_holes: 4 more round features (holes) are drawn but their positions are not dimensioned: below the top-right mounting hole, right of the NPU, below-left of the NPU, and above the bottom-left mounting hole

colors.pcb: green solder mask (same Raspberry Pi green as the Pi 5), white silkscreen: Raspberry Pi logo, 'AI HAT+', TOPS rating and a Hailo logo
colors.npu: silver/brushed-metal lid on the Hailo chip, laser-marked 'HAILO'
colors.header: black 2x20 female stacking header with gold pins
colors.pads: the mounting holes look like they have gold/ENIG ring pads in photos (mostly hidden under the screws)
colors.ffc: orange/amber polyimide PCIe flat cable with a white FFC connector

search_log: pip.raspberrypi.com category 1081 (AI HAT+): only the product brief plus approvals and test reports. No STEP. Pi 5 category 892 has STEP files but none for the HAT. The Design Files category 1096 has only CM5 STEPs
datasheets.raspberrypi.com/ai-hat-plus/: product brief only (no mechanical PDF or STEP at guessed paths)
raspberrypi.com/documentation/accessories/ai-hat-plus: dimensioned PNG drawing, no CAD link
GitHub (gh search repos/code), Waveshare wiki, DigiKey/Mouser/Farnell listings: nothing

Printables model 1549408 'Pi Ai hat+ model' (CC-BY-SA, user NIe3Dprint, description just 'model'): a 2868-triangle STL measuring 65.02 x 56.39 x 6.35 (inch-rounded) with a ~2.8 mm thick board. A crude approximation, so it was downloaded, checked and deleted. Not used
notes: No official or reputable 3D CAD exists publicly for the AI HAT+, so it has to be modelled by hand from the official drawing. The 13 TOPS (SC1785, Hailo-8L) and 26 TOPS (SC1791, Hailo-8) variants share one product brief and one mechanical drawing. Every official photo found (Raspberry Pi docs hero, SparkFun's 13 TOPS listing) shows the 26 TOPS board: silkscreen '26 TOPS', Hailo-8 marking. The 13 TOPS board should differ only in the TOPS silkscreen and chip marking, but no official 13 TOPS close-up was found to confirm that. Component placement beyond the dimensioned items (NPU, header, FFC connector, holes) must come from the photos. Not in the drawing: Hailo package height, PCB thickness, header height (supplied stacking header is 16 mm).
